purpose: Resolve literal generated-source semantics before integrating configurable native network transport

native_source.scope: Execute pinned AST methods and generated expressions; no upstream imports, full simulation or native geometry/update equivalence

implemented_source_contract.reversible: rho * availability * vmax * alpha * product(loading/(1+loading)) * (1 - Q/Keq)
implemented_source_contract.irreversible: standard free energy None removes Q, Keq and electrical reversal from the rate
implemented_source_contract.product_Km: Generated backward saturation is absent from the executable final expression
implemented_source_contract.Q: product(1e-3 * product_concentration ** product_multiplier) / product(1e-3 * reactant_concentration ** reactant_multiplier)
implemented_source_contract.Q_source_limit: The literal 1e-3 is outside each power; do not silently substitute (1e-3*c)**n
implemented_source_contract.electrical_transfer_energy: F*Vm*(sum(imported reactant coefficients*z) - sum(exported product coefficients*z))
implemented_source_contract.native_net_z: sum(exported product coefficients*z) - sum(imported reactant coefficients*z)
implemented_source_contract.influencers: Product of regular activator Hills plus sum of independent ! Hills, multiplied by inhibitor Hills and optional sum of direct & activators minus direct & inhibitors
implemented_source_contract.independent_only: Activator expression starts at 1 when there are only independent activators
implemented_source_contract.influencer_zones: write_transporters does not forward configured zone lists; get_influencers defaults all regulators to cell/membrane concentrations
implemented_source_contract.star_suffix: write_transporters sets in_mem_tag=False, so * requests do not make transporter regulator Km voltage sensitive
implemented_source_contract.direct_inhibitors: Can make alpha and density negative; source correspondence does not imply passive dissipation

supported_domain.zone: cell only, explicit inside/outside ownership supplied by composing model
supported_domain.substrates: Finite strictly positive participating reactant/product concentrations, even when blocked
supported_domain.other_species: Finite nonnegative active concentrations; inactive compartments are exactly zero
supported_domain.multipliers: Positive finite real active coefficients; zero denotes internal padding only
supported_domain.regulation: Finite nonnegative regulator concentrations, positive finite Km and Hill exponents
supported_domain.topology: Unique species/names, nonempty reactant and product lists per active route, explicit transfer flags, charge-conserving configured reactions; reversible routes require at least one transfer term
supported_domain.direct_inhibitor_order: A direct & inhibitor is sole or last; other orders trigger malformed expressions or changed operator precedence in the pinned native generator and are rejected
supported_domain.direct_only_groups: Simultaneous only-direct activator and only-direct inhibitor groups leave an empty tuple in the native expression; rejected before evaluation
supported_domain.controls: Finite nonnegative rho; availability in [0,1]; inactive routes have zero controls/parameters
supported_domain.temperature: Finite positive isothermal K per independent world
supported_domain.numerics: Finite representable rates, currents, owner updates and diagnostic driving energies

reference: Independent scalar 80-digit Decimal formula and owner loops, without Cells/NumPy/JAX imports
scope_limits: Component law and conservative owner accumulation only; shared dispatch/schema/checkpoints remain separate integration work
No manufactured tanh/KCC/NKCC law replacement or fitted isoform claim
No mitochondrial transport, native geometry concentration stepping, reservoir semantics or membrane-shell update equivalence
No implicit ATP demand, repair cost, water drag, osmotic term or physical heat/free-energy ledger
Source driving energy is diagnostic: literal Q conversion and direct influencers do not establish thermodynamic consistency
No floors, clamping, depletion repair, silent native bug correction or full-cell settling/qualification claim
